def test_my_create_schedule(self):
        try:
            user_btn_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            for user_btn in user_btn_list:
                # 查找日程管理的btn
                if user_btn.text == home_user_schedule_btn_name:
                    user_btn.click()

                    self.logger.info(f"点击日程管理后")
                    self.capture(f"点击日程管理后_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)
                    break

            # 等待加载控件
            self.page.wait_for(self.page.element_is_exists(home_user_schedule_create_remind_menu_element, max_timeout=max_timeout))

            # 切换到 创建日程tab
            create_remind_menu_btn_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_schedule_create_remind_menu_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            create_remind_menu_btn = create_remind_menu_btn_list[0]

            create_remind_menu_btn.tap()

            self.logger.info(f"点击切换到创建日程菜单")
            self.capture(f"点击切换到创建日程菜单_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            create_btn = self.page.get_element(home_user_schedule_create_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            create_btn.click()

            self.logger.info(f"点击创建btn")
            self.capture(f"点击创建btn_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 输入日程标题

            self.page.wait_for(self.page.element_is_exists(home_user_schedule_title_element, max_timeout=max_timeout))

            # 随机生成1-300字内容
            self.logger.info("生成随机文本内容...")
            random_content = random_text_generator.generate_random_text(
                min_len=1,
                max_len=30,
                chinese_ratio=0.8  # 80%中文+20%英文
            )
            self.logger.info(f"生成随机文本（长度：{len(random_content)} 字）：{random_content[:30]}...")  # 只打印前50字避免日志过长

            # 输入到日程管理 标题输入框
            self.logger.info("向输入框输入内容...")
            input_box = self.page.get_element(home_user_schedule_title_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            input_box.input(random_content)
            self.logger.info("文本输入成功")

            # 验证输入内容是否正确
            title_inputted_text = input_box.attribute("value")
            assert title_inputted_text == [random_content], f"输入内容不一致：预期{[random_content]}，实际{title_inputted_text}"
            self.logger.info("输入内容验证成功")

            self.logger.info(f"输入日程标题: {title_inputted_text}")
            self.capture(f"输入日程标题_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 选择日程位置

            # 点击箭头
            arrow_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_arrow_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            arrow = arrow_list[0]
            arrow.tap()

            address_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_schedule_address_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            # 随机选择一个位置
            address = random.choice(address_list)
            address.tap()

            # 位置名称和详细
            select_address = self.page.get_element(home_user_schedule_select_address_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            select_address_name_text = select_address.get_element(home_user_schedule_select_address_name_element, max_timeout=max_timeout).text
            select_address_street_text = select_address.get_element(home_user_schedule_select_address_street_element, max_timeout=max_timeout).text

            select_address_text = select_address_name_text + ' · ' + select_address_street_text

            if select_address_text is None:
                self.logger.info(f"未选择日程位置")
            else:
                self.logger.info(f"已选择日程位置: {select_address_text}")
            self.capture(f"点击日程位置_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 选择日程受邀人

            # 点击箭头
            arrow_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_arrow_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            arrow = arrow_list[1]
            arrow.tap()

            # 受邀人列表
            friend_checkbox_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_schedule_friend_checkbox_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            friend_checkbox_list_len = len(friend_checkbox_list)

            self.logger.info(f"当前受邀人列表共有 {friend_checkbox_list_len} 位好友")
            self.capture(f"受邀人列表_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 随机数 N
            friend_checkbox_random = random.randint(0,friend_checkbox_list_len)
            self.logger.info(f"应随机选择 {friend_checkbox_random} 条受邀人数据")

            if friend_checkbox_random != 0:
                # 随机选择 N 条数据
                friend_checkbox_sample_list = random.sample(friend_checkbox_list, friend_checkbox_random)

                for friend_checkbox_sample in friend_checkbox_sample_list:
                    friend_checkbox_sample.tap()

                    self.logger.info(f"已选择受邀人: {friend_checkbox_sample.text} ")
                self.capture(f"已选择受邀人_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 点击保存
            click_save_btn(self)

            # 选择日程提醒

            # 点击箭头
            arrow_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_arrow_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            arrow = arrow_list[2]
            arrow.tap()

            reminder_time_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_schedule_reminder_time_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            # 随机数 N
            reminder_time_random = random.randint(0,len(reminder_time_list))
            self.logger.info(f"应随机选择 {reminder_time_random} 条提醒时间")

            if reminder_time_random != 0:
                # 随机选择 N 条数据
                friend_checkbox_sample_list = random.sample(reminder_time_list, reminder_time_random)

                for friend_checkbox_sample in friend_checkbox_sample_list:
                    friend_checkbox_sample.tap()

                    self.logger.info(f"已选择提醒时间: {friend_checkbox_sample.text} ")
                self.capture(f"已选择提醒时间_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 点击保存
            confirm_btn_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_schedule_reminder_time_confirm_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            for confirm_btn in confirm_btn_list:
                if confirm_btn.text == home_user_schedule_reminder_time_confirm_btn_name:
                    confirm_btn.tap()

                    self.logger.info(f"已点击提醒时间的 {confirm_btn.text} ")
                    self.capture(f"已点击提醒时间的{confirm_btn.text}_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 输入日程备注

            # 随机生成1-300字内容
            self.logger.info("生成随机文本内容...")
            random_content = random_text_generator.generate_random_text(
                min_len=0,
                max_len=3000,
                chinese_ratio=0.8  # 80%中文+20%英文
            )
            self.logger.info(f"生成随机文本（长度：{len(random_content)} 字）：{random_content[:50]}...")  # 只打印前50字避免日志过长

            # 输入到日程管理 备注输入框
            self.logger.info("向输入框输入内容...")
            input_box = self.page.get_element(home_user_schedule_remark_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            input_box.input(random_content)
            self.logger.info("文本输入成功")

            # 验证输入内容是否正确
            remark_inputted_text = input_box.attribute("value")
            assert remark_inputted_text == [random_content], f"输入内容不一致：预期{[random_content]}，实际{remark_inputted_text}"
            self.logger.info("输入内容验证成功")

            self.logger.info(f"输入日程备注: {remark_inputted_text}")
            self.capture(f"输入日程备注_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            # 点击保存
            save_btn = self.page.get_element(home_user_schedule_save_btn_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)
            save_btn.tap()

            self.logger.info(f"保存日程")
            self.capture(f"保存日程_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)

            time.sleep(2)

            self.native.handle_modal("取消")

            # 判断日程创建成功
            schedule_list = self.page.get_elements(home_user_schedule_list_element, max_timeout=max_timeout)

            is_True = False

            for schedule in schedule_list:
                self.logger.info(f"日程标题 1 :{schedule.text}")
                self.logger.info(f"日程标题 2 :{title_inputted_text[0]}")

                if schedule.text == title_inputted_text[0]:
                    is_True = True
                    self.logger.info(f"日程创建成功")
                    self.capture(f"日程创建成功_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}", region=self.page)
                    break

            assert is_True == True,f"日程创建失败，请手动检查"


        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"创建日程失败：{str(e)}")
            # 异常时截图
            self.capture(f"创建日程失败_{time.strftime("%H%M%S")}")

            time.sleep(1)

            raise
